_about: Yardstick for the vocabulary generation prompts. Each word states the sense count a careful reader of contemporary press and literary prose would expect, keywords that must appear in the FIRST definition, keywords that fail the first definition when present, keywords that must appear somewhere (required_any), and keywords that mark an invented sense anywhere (must_not). Keywords are matched case-insensitively against the English definitions. Change an expectation only with a written reason.

words.why: The word lives almost entirely in 'avoir/etre dans le collimateur'; the optical instrument is a technical sense a reader never meets.
'avoir recours a' is the everyday use; the legal appeal is a domain sense and belongs second if at all.
